classes.name: results
classes.reason: write_staged() explicitly calls os.fsync(fd) after the write, so the rank issuing it must wait for the data to be durable before returning, and this happens inside the per-rank task loop with no barrier per file, so only the writing rank stalls.

classes.name: diagnostics
classes.reason: write_buffered() only does os.write then os.close with no fsync, so the write can be buffered by the OS and overlaps with the rank's subsequent task-loop work, and since each rank writes its own g%d_t%d file independently between barrier.wait() calls, no other rank is blocked by it.
